title: Rhinoceros · archive operation

source.why_this_clip: A rhinoceros in side view fills most of the frame, grazing with its head down, shifting its legs and swinging its head and tail. Cuts are at 3.25 s and 7.75 s, so 3.5 to 7.5 s is one continuous shot.

source_selection.evidence: Sixteen raw-source samples visually inspected in preflight/source-design-sheet.jpg; final source-contact-sheet.jpg additionally spans refined clock interval. No cut/dissolve in selected event.

vector_observation_clock.method: Estimated local pixel appearance correspondence between frozen SAM JPEGs and retained raw frames; grayscale96x72RMSE<=2 andrunnerupgap>=.25. Ambiguous samples use clock interpolation between accepted anchors, or nominal12fps extrapolation at ends.

assembly_summary: The original seven-stroke rhinoceros grazes head-down, shifts within the frame and swishes a separately credited tail. Enclosure geometry follows a camera separate from the native cast.
review_note: Bounded v2 repair awaiting fresh independent still critique. Normal-speed playback remains unrun; no training ran.
